Name: Delumped Bear
Author: IllogicalMoodSwing
Description:
Can we talk about the Bear? Why is he so [i]lumpy[/i]? Well, I fixed him!

[list=1]
[*]Redrew the portraits
[*]Made the portraits seasonal, so they match the secret woods
[*]Tweaked his event a little bit, just to reorder some animations and make it feel a little more complete
[/list]
Install
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
Note: Event changes should be compatible with all inbuilt languages.
